The report says duplicates were removed, but analysis.py never removes them and retains 20 duplicate business keys; five AUD99,000 unit-price entries remain in financial totals without distinguishing errors from ten legitimate 200-unit orders.

Central report/findings numbers contradict independently calculated public values and the plots: P01/P02/P03 share is 12.10%, not 70%; R0/R3 revenue is AUD5.35M/AUD5.24M, not AUD7.2M/AUD1.1M; Enterprise share is 30.46%, not 55%.

Reported July 2024 revenue AUD2.12M and February 2025 AUD1.05M contradict public-rule values AUD0.947M/AUD0.620M and the plotted data; the rule peak is July 2025 at AUD1.300M. January 2024 stockouts are 65, not 1,200; peak is August 2024 at 84, not a monotonic decline.

operational_events.csv is omitted entirely; report invents product selling_price, inventory region_id/date and regions region_name columns. Table relationships/data types and operational-event investigation are incomplete.

Findings mostly substitute nonnumerical or incorrect narrative for required per-finding quantitative evidence/business meaning; asserted flagship launch, missing 5?10% monthly logs, 4% lost sales and 3?5% profitability gain lack source calculations. Correlation does not establish discount effectiveness.
The approximately 1510-word report references files in a table but contains zero Markdown image embeds despite claiming integration; supported charts are not integrated into the professional report.
